title:
Is triggered when a user clicks on the "Start Training" button in the Cloning Model UI, and the validation ran by
`ValidateModelCloningUserInputEpic` has passed.

This Epic will do the following:
- Retrieve and construct a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.UnifiedModelCloningJob.Spec} using the data from the
  {@link CloningModelApplicationState}, {@link ModelConfigApplicationState#hyperparameterOverrides} and data grid
  `Reliability.CloningModelTimeWindowTrainingDatesFormDataGrid`.
- Call {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.UnifiedModelCloningJob#createAndStartWorkflow} to initialize the cloning model
  process.
- Will redirect the user to `reliability/model-setup-jobs`.
- Finally will ensure the {@link CloningModelApplicationState} and Model Cloning page is clear.

**NOTE**: In case of some failure at {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.UnifiedModelCloningJob#createAndStartWorkflow}
          the epic will shown an error banner and keep the user in the modal.
name: CloningModelStartTrainingEpic
